question_en: How did the NVDA executive bonus plans for fiscal 2026 and fiscal 2027 compare in when they were adopted, what metric drives the payout, and when each fiscal year ends?
question_vi: Kế hoạch thưởng tiền mặt cho lãnh đạo của NVDA năm tài chính 2026 và năm tài chính 2027 khác nhau thế nào về ngày thông qua, chỉ tiêu quyết định mức thưởng và ngày kết thúc năm tài chính?
reference_answer: The fiscal 2026 plan was adopted on March 3, 2025, with goals based on fiscal 2026 revenue, for a fiscal year ending January 25, 2026. The fiscal 2027 plan was adopted on March 2, 2026, with goals based on fiscal 2027 revenue, for a fiscal year ending January 31, 2027; both set threshold, base and stretch levels.
evidence_quotes: Fiscal year 2026 refers to the Company’s fiscal year ending January 25, 2026.

The Compensation Committee has set the Performance Goals for fiscal year 2026 based upon the achievement of specified fiscal year 2026 revenue and has established threshold compensation plan, base compensation plan, and stretch compensation plan levels.
Fiscal year 2027 refers to the Company’s fiscal year ending January 31, 2027.

The Compensation Committee has set the Performance Goals for fiscal year 2027 based upon the achievement of specified fiscal year 2027 revenue and has established threshold compensation plan, base compensation plan, and stretch compensation plan levels.

question_en: How did MSFT change its 10-Q risk factor about the nation-state hack of its corporate email between Q1 FY2025 and Q1 FY2026?
question_vi: Mô tả rủi ro về vụ tin tặc được nhà nước hậu thuẫn xâm nhập email nội bộ trong báo cáo 10-Q của MSFT đã thay đổi thế nào giữa quý 1 năm tài chính 2025 và quý 1 năm tài chính 2026?
reference_answer: In Q1 FY2025 Microsoft said the actor used and may continue to use the stolen information and that it may discover additional impacts in its ongoing examination; it cited patching failures on legacy network equipment. In Q1 FY2026 it dropped the ongoing-examination sentence, said the actor could continue to use this and other information to attempt access, and cited end-of-life and end-of-support equipment instead.
evidence_quotes: Additionally, we may discover additional impacts of this or other incidents as part of our ongoing examination of this incident.

Challenges or failures in applying current security patches to all hardware and devices connected to our systems, including legacy network equipment, have and may continue to result in unauthorized access to our IT systems and data in the future.

Challenges or failures in applying security patches to all hardware and devices connected to our systems, including end-of-life and end-of-support equipment, have and may continue to result in unauthorized access to our systems and data in the future.

question_en: By how many Class C shares did Alphabet shareholders enlarge the 2021 Stock Plan reserve at the June 2022 annual meeting, and at the June 2023 meeting?
question_vi: Cổ đông Alphabet đã chấp thuận tăng quỹ cổ phiếu của Kế hoạch cổ phiếu 2021 thêm bao nhiêu cổ phiếu loại C tại đại hội thường niên tháng 6/2022, và tại đại hội tháng 6/2023?
reference_answer: At the June 1, 2022 annual meeting, shareholders approved increasing the 2021 Stock Plan reserve by 4,000,000 Class C shares. At the June 2, 2023 annual meeting, they approved an increase of 170,000,000 Class C shares.
evidence_quotes: Alphabet’s stockholders approved an amendment to Alphabet Inc. 2021 Stock Plan (the “2021 Stock Plan”) to increase the share reserve by 4,000,000 shares of Class C capital stock.

Alphabet’s stockholders approved the amendment and restatement of the Alphabet Inc. Amended and Restated 2021 Stock Plan (the “2021 Stock Plan”) to increase the share reserve by 170,000,000 shares of Class C capital stock.
